A '''mastery ritual''' was a test performed by the [[Ysanna/Legends|Ysanna]] tribe of [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]], in which a [[Shaman/Legends|shaman]] visited the [[Crystal Caves (Ossus)/Legends|Crystal Caves]] and entered [[Meditation/Legends|meditation]] to face their inner ghosts. At the end of the ritual, the shaman received a vision of their destiny.<ref name="NoP" />
